nights.title: Paris Jackson
nights.name: Paris Jackson
nights.extract: Paris-Michael Katherine Jackson is an American model, actress, and singer. The second child and daughter of Michael Jackson and Debbie Rowe, Jackson signed a deal with Republic Records in 2020. Her debut album, Wilted, was released that year.

en.who: Paris-Michael Katherine Jackson is an American model, actress and singer. She is the second child and daughter of Michael Jackson and Debbie Rowe.
facts: Jackson signed a deal with Republic Records in 2020.
Her debut album, Wilted, was released that year.

de.who: Paris-Michael Katherine Jackson ist ein amerikanisches model, schauspielerin und sängerin. Sie ist das zweite kind und die tochter von Michael Jackson und Debbie Rowe.
facts: Jackson unterzeichnete 2020 einen vertrag mit Republic Records.
Ihr debütalbum Wilted erschien im selben jahr.

tr.who: Paris-Michael Katherine Jackson, amerikalı bir model, oyuncu ve şarkıcıdır. Michael Jackson ve Debbie Rowe'un ikinci çocuğu ve kızıdır.
facts: Jackson, 2020'de Republic Records ile bir anlaşma imzaladı.
Debut albümü Wilted o yıl yayımlandı.
